findings.description: Closing a source citation dialog with Escape leaves focus on BODY instead of restoring the invoking button. Reproduced in Messages, Ask AeroContext and the monthly evidence table.
The skip-to-content control is included in English and Chinese PDFs, overlapping report content near the bottom of page 1 and appearing again on page 2.

limits: Controlled provider responses test application behavior, not live DeepSeek reliability or reasoning.
This run used existing copied dependencies; a documented fresh npm install and hosted/Docker verification remain separate tasks.
A suspected right-margin overflow was not confirmed on reinspection of the saved PDF renders.
